title: Why Your Prints Never Match Your Screen — and How to Fix It
excerpt: A monitor makes light; paper reflects it. The fix is a small chain of translations — a calibrated monitor, soft proofing, and one color manager, never two.

title: Is It Time to Upgrade Your Camera? A Marsh Test Answers It
excerpt: Omar Gonzalez took a 2018 Fujifilm X-H1 into a marsh to ask the honest question: does fighting old gear make you better, or does it just cost you shots?

title: Canon, Nikon, Sony and Fujifilm Each See Your Future Differently
excerpt: Nikkei asked all four camera giants where photography is headed. Canon bets on the shooting experience, Nikon on cascading flagship tech down, Sony on Spatial AI, Fujifilm on the joy of the dial.
